summary: Comprehensive testing of WINEK profile user feature iteration 16: show_phone/show_reviews toggles in edit-profile, public profile with interests/phone/reviews, and review submission system. 29/29 backend tests passed after fixing JSONB coach_tags bug. All frontend features working correctly.

critical.issue: Returned 500 for users with non-empty coach_tags. Root cause: asyncpg JSONB codec not decoding coach_tags field to Python list - arrived as raw JSON string. Fixed with isinstance(tag_ids, str) + json.loads() fallback in user_routes.py

ui_bugs.issue: React Native Switch testID prop does not propagate to data-testid on the input DOM element. The switch renders as INPUT[role=switch] without data-testid. testID works on wrapper DIVs but not on the switch input itself.

integration_issues.issue: When user visits a profile where they already have a review (created externally e.g. via API), the review form may still be shown on initial page load. The alreadyReviewed state check runs correctly but the form showing is inconsistent. Backend correctly returns 409 on duplicate submit, preventing actual double-submission.

action_items: FIXED (by T1): JSONB coach_tags bug in GET /api/users/{id}/public - see /app/backend/routes/user_routes.py
Consider fixing alreadyReviewed detection: ensure loadReviews waits for me (auth context) to be fully loaded before checking reviewer_id match
Optional: Propagate testID to underlying Switch input element for better testability (React Native Switch doesn't forward testID to the DOM input in web)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: JSONB coach_tags in GET /api/users/{id}/public was not being deserialized properly - asyncpg returned string instead of list. Fixed with isinstance check + json.loads fallback.
show_phone and show_reviews correctly present in USER_FIELDS in auth_utils.py - login response includes these fields
UserUpdate model correctly includes show_phone and show_reviews as Optional[bool]
reviews table booking_id column is nullable which correctly supports the new direct profile review (NULL booking_id) feature
Duplicate review detection uses correct WHERE clause: reviewer_id + reviewee_id + booking_id IS NULL
Phone visibility correctly implemented: user.phone set to None when show_phone=False in public profile endpoint

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all key features working, minor alreadyReviewed detection inconsistency)

seed_data_creation: Review from user_demo001 to user_coach001 (rating=5, 'TEST_Excellent coach, très professionnel!'). Review from user_coach001 to user_demo002 (rating=4, 'TEST_Avis depuis frontend coach!'). Review from user_coach001 to user_demo001 (rating=4, no comment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new API endpoints tested and working: GET /api/users/{id}/public (with interests, conditional phone, avg_rating, review_count), GET /api/users/{id}/reviews (list with reviewer info), POST /api/users/{id}/reviews (create with validation). CRITICAL BUG WAS FIXED: coach_tags JSONB deserialization in public profile endpoint. The Switch toggle data-testid is not accessible via DOM (use role=switch to find switches instead). For frontend testing use /user/user_demo002 as a test target - it has 2 reviews and shows all sections.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: asyncpg JSONB codec set in _init_connection should decode JSONB columns to Python objects. However, the SELECT query in get_public_profile fetches coach_tags from the users table. When coach_tags is non-empty (e.g. ['tag_musculation', 'tag_hiit', 'tag_cardio']), row_to_dict receives it but the value arrives as a JSON string. Fix: added isinstance(tag_ids, str) check with json.loads() fallback before passing to ANY($1::text[]) query.
